author: eustace0451
quote: Honestly, GTA 6 feels like a marketing campaign that happens to come with a game. We've been fed trailers for years, and every time one drops, the internet goes nuts and the media jumps right on it. Headlines call it the most important game ever, and nobody has even played it yet. That's not excitement, that's a hype machine doing its **** let's be real, Rockstar and its parent company are in this for the money. Look at how they handled GTA Online: endless microtransactions, Shark Cards, grinding built to make you pay. Do you really think GTA 6 will be different? A huge, pretty open world is easy to build when you have that much cash. Making it actually fun and meaningful is the hard part.What bugs me most is how the gaming press treats it. Big budget and big name seem to count as "art" now. That's not criticism anymore, that's free advertising. If GTA 6 ends up a massive success, it won't be because it earned it. It'll be because the hype worked.
